answers.text: Skip the famous halls at lunch. Go one neighbourhood over for the small market counters, then walk it off on the quiet park paths.

asks.text: I am in New York, I have 2 hours, $40, no crowds, I love food.

drops.costRange: Free to enter, bring $10 for coffee after
drops.exactPlace: Meet at the Pool, West 100th-103rd St entrance, Central Park
drops.fuzzyLocation: North end of Central Park, about a 10 minute walk from the nearest subway stop
drops.meetDetail: Steph waits by the west side of the Pool with binoculars to lend.
drops.title: Central Park is loud today. The north woods are not.
drops.warning: Paths are muddy after rain. Wear shoes that can get dirty.
drops.whyNow: Weekend crowds stay south. This morning the warblers are moving through the quiet north end, and almost nobody walks up there before 10.

drops.exactPlace: Exact cafe name and address revealed on unlock (demo Drop)
drops.fuzzyLocation: Cambridge side of the river, a short walk from a Red Line stop
drops.meetDetail: Marcus can meet you outside and introduce you to the owner.
drops.perfectFor: Readers, families escaping the rain, anyone with 2 slow hours
drops.title: Rainy in Boston? Skip the long queue, this bookstore cafe is warm.
drops.warning: It seats about twenty people. If it fills, it fills. Go before 2 pm.
drops.whyNow: The famous history stops have school groups in the rain today. This small bookstore cafe is quiet, cheap, and the owner is in until 4.

drops.exactPlace: Exact shore access point revealed on unlock (demo Drop)
drops.fuzzyLocation: Quiet shore on the Ellsworth side of the bay, about 20 minutes from the busy park entrances
drops.meetDetail: Suzy can meet you at the trailhead at 6:30 pm.
drops.perfectFor: Sunset without the crowd, photographers, couples
drops.title: Acadia is packed. A quieter sunset spot 20 minutes away.
drops.warning: Rocks are slippery at dusk. Bring a torch for the walk back.
drops.whyNow: Cadillac's sunset lots fill by 5. This shore spot faces the same light with a fraction of the people, and tonight's sky is clear.

drops.exactPlace: Exact meeting point revealed on unlock (demo Drop)
drops.fuzzyLocation: A quiet river mouth within 25 minutes of Ellsworth
drops.meetDetail: Seth brings the rods. You bring warm layers.
drops.perfectFor: Beginners who want to actually catch something
drops.title: The tide turns at dawn. That is when the fish are honest.
drops.warning: You need a Maine fishing licence for the day. Seth can tell you where to get one.
drops.whyNow: Tomorrow's early tide and light wind line up. Seth is free at first light and the usual spots will still be empty.

drops.exactPlace: Exact street and first stall revealed on unlock (demo Drop)
drops.fuzzyLocation: Central Kyoto, a few minutes from the famous market street
drops.meetDetail: Yuki S. meets you at the corner lantern at 6:30 pm.
drops.perfectFor: Food lovers who want the real evening Kyoto
drops.title: Skip the famous food street tonight. Locals eat one street over.
drops.warning: Many stalls are cash only, and photos are not welcome everywhere. Follow Yuki's lead.
drops.whyNow: The famous market street is at its most crowded this evening. The parallel street, where shop staff eat after work, is at its best after 6.

drops.costRange: Entrance ticket plus Dula's walk price
drops.exactPlace: Exact dawn meeting point revealed on unlock (demo Drop)
drops.fuzzyLocation: Village side of Sigiriya, away from the main tour bus entrance
drops.meetDetail: Dula meets you at the tank bund at 5:45 am with binoculars.
drops.perfectFor: Early risers, birders, anyone who hates queues
drops.title: Sigiriya before the buses: birds, tanks, and the rock in morning light.
drops.warning: Start before sunrise. Carry water, there is none on the steps.
drops.whyNow: By 9 the rock is busy and hot. At dawn the village tanks are full of birds and you can be up and down before the crowds arrive.
